smart slopes

All the trails of Dolomiti NordicSki in live status

Discover daily groomed trails in the unique landscape of the Dolomites.

All regions at a glance – real-time trail updates from the Dolomiti NordicSki network. Check snow conditions, grooming status and open tracks.

Our trails are for everyone who shares the joy of cross-country skiing.
Please do not enter them on foot or with sleds,touring ski, bicycles or dogs – this keeps the tracks safe and in top condition for everyone. Thank you for helping us to protect them.

Opening hours cross-country ski tracks: 8.30am-5.00pm.
The use of the cross-country tracks is prohibited outside the opening hours.

Important: The trail list and status shown here are indicative only. To check the real-time status of the trails, please click on “open trail”. 

Dolomiti NordicSki accepts no responsibility for the content or its updating.
